errors.text_span: Оста Y е обозначена с приходи в трилиони долари
errors.evidence: The Y-axis has no label. The units 'трилиони долари' (trillion dollars) are specified in the legend for the blue series, not as a general axis label.
The chart is a combination of an area chart (the blue filled area) and a line chart (the orange line), not two line charts.
The value for the data series 'Обобщени данни' in 2017 is explicitly labeled as 9,50, not 0.50.

This sentence completely misinterprets the orange line and its labels. The percentages are labels for year-over-year growth, not Y-axis coordinates. The Y-axis is in trillions of dollars. Furthermore, the values are misaligned with the years; for example, the 14% growth corresponds to 2018, not 2017. The value for 2021 is 16%, not 19%.

errors.text_span: В областта между двете линии са отбелязани числови стойности, които представляват величините на графиките в съответните години.
errors.evidence: The numerical values for revenue (9,50, 10,80, etc.) are located inside the blue area chart, not 'between the two lines'. Also, these values correspond only to the 'Обобщени данни' series, not both 'графиките' (the charts/plots).
